decisions.reason: The hearty bread loaf builds directly on the firm's core baking knowledge, so management can read its sales and adjust it in-house, though it has not been visible since 2018–2019 and could be quietly rotated out of the range.
The sweet pastry fits the firm's confectionery expertise and is easy to refine with existing know-how, though the pastry assortment is more prone to rotation than staple breads.
The crusty farmhouse bread is a staple close to the firm's heritage baking craft, so the firm can absorb customer feedback and keep improving it without outside research.
The poppy seed stollen is a flagship that won a gold award, an external quality signal the firm can readily interpret through its stollen tradition, so it is a strong keep.
The premium stollen also won gold and draws on the firm's established seasonal craft knowledge, making it a reliable, well-understood Christmas product worth keeping.
